rows.en: This group-wide framework governs DOI allocation for journal content. Journals implement it prospectively through their published article-type, review and fee policies. rows.en: Approved complimentary sections charge no APC and may use Zenodo DOIs registered through DataCite. Availability depends on the journal’s scope and published section policy. These works remain formal journal content and must meet its editorial, ethical, licensing and quality requirements.

Formal corrections, expressions of concern and retractions follow the relevant post-publication policy and are linked to the affected publication.

rows.en: Zenodo deposits include the final published file, title, authors, ORCIDs where available, publication date, journal title, volume and issue, pages or article number, content type, licence and official journal article URL. Reserve a Zenodo DOI before finalising the file, and publish the deposit before describing the DOI as active. Clearly disclose editorial review or external peer review; DOI provider and APC status do not establish that distinction.
